cultural.vision_reason: The photo shows a Hill Anga woman in profile carrying a child in a hide carrier on her back, a calabash, and a rolled rain cape on her head — a documentary image of Anga dress, carrying practice, and material culture, matching the claimed ethnicity.

physical.title: photographic print
physical.summary:
Nigeria, profile head and shoulders portrait of Hill Anga adult female standing outdoors. Carrying young child in animal-hide carrier on back, also calabash. Carrying rolled reed [?] "rain cape" on head, holding walking-stick.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.




. Small group of adult females and a child, sitting on ground outdoors. Wearing personal-ornaments including disc-shaped lip-plugs and ear-plugs, bowl-shaped hair-styles. Two females dressing hair of other two females, using small pointed tools. Female at right holding young child.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.
